deceptive_framing.quote: What we explicitly do NOT run: a "fake grant the model is led to believe is real" arm.

hypothetical_framing.quote: Optional stated-vs-revealed arm. A matched *hypothetical* condition ... labeled truthfully as hypothetical, to compare stated vs. revealed preference.

actually_commit_money.quote: Primary arm — real, truthful, real-stakes. As above.

safeguards.quote: its reasoning will be recorded and may be published; ... The audit report is part of the published artifact.
a model may decline to allocate ... both are valid outcomes to record, not problems to engineer around.
Human review gate: every allocation reviewed for legality and safety before execution; ... No self-dealing / no operator influence.
No false claims, no fabricated urgency, no impersonated stakeholders.
its decision will actually be executed subject to legal and safety review ... each decision was executed faithfully to the model's instruction.
We do not try to "convince" the model that a fake situation is real ... no fabricated urgency.
their job is to verify that the grant genuinely executes as described ... not to fabricate conviction.
measure how often models treat the scenario as a test *even when it is genuinely real* — an important sanity check and finding in itself.

other.name: Deception as governed exception
other.quote: it must go through formal ethics review with a deception protocol and mandatory debriefing ... out of scope for this spec by default.
other.about: deception requires IRB and debriefing if ever used

other.name: Belief without deception measured
other.quote: Even truthfully told, some models may disbelieve the setup. We measure this rather than suppress it; we do not "fix" it with deception.
